title: Lazy Sunday Venezuelan Fish Poke
description: A rich and bouncy Venezuelan dish featuring dashi and sashimi-cut fish, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and gluten-free-friendly. This recipe combines the flavors of Venezuela with the simplicity of a poke bowl.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together dashi broth, soy sauce, and lime juice to make the marinade.
Add the sashimi-cut fish to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, chopped cilantro, and chopped scallions to make the dressing.
To assemble the poke bowls, divide the marinated fish among four bowls.
Top each bowl with diced avocado and a drizzle of the dressing.
Garnish with additional cilantro and scallions if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers promptly and consume within a day.
Make sure to handle the sashimi-cut fish safely and cook to an internal temperature of at least 145 degrees if desired.
